assessment.notes: Public-source research snapshot. No inference of illegality from lobbying, contracts, former government service or political relationships.

known_limitations: Classified contract scope is not public.
Some award pages expose aliases or child recipient profiles.
Q2 2026 lobbying filings can still be amended after the research cutoff.
State, local and foreign lobbying regimes are not fully captured.
Commercial customer identities and contract values are often confidential.
data.name: Palantir deep-dive methodology
rules: Prefer SEC, LDA, USAspending, SAM.gov, DoD/Army, NHS and UK tender records.
Treat ceilings, potential values, obligations, outlays and recognized revenue as different measures.
Use latest amended lobbying filing and exclude superseded versions.
Do not double-count subcontractors when the primary registrant reports the income.
Model prior government employment as a revolving-door indicator, not wrongdoing.
Label corporate statements, advocacy claims and analytical inferences by source type.
Preserve uncertainty when award records were surfaced but not fully normalized.

migration_notes: Normalized into the canonical StarIntel v0.9.0 document envelope.
